title: The Family Circle
learning_focus: Family roles in supporting puberty changes; communication, respect, routines, and trusted support.
story_premise: A family camp has lost its support map. The player helps different households identify helpful roles without assuming every family has the same structure.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Family roles in supporting puberty changes; communication, respect, routines, and trusted support.
